blocks.text: Most adventurers kill the Ender Dragon once and call the story finished. A wing-smith knows better: each time the dragon falls, the End gives back a little more of what it hid.

The mod counts every dragon death in your world. If your world had already killed its first dragon before the mod arrived, that one is counted too. Summon the dragon again with four End Crystals on the exit portal, as usual.

1st death: the Summoning Sanctum appears, floating at the very top of the End sky above the central island.
2nd death: the Sky Sanctum and its Assembly Table, with the Sanctum Compass.
3rd death: the Wing Forge and its Forge Bench, with the Forge Compass.
4th death: the Cloud Refinery and its Cloud Compressor, with the Refinery Compass.
5th death: the Offering Fountain rises on a fourth island; the Fountain Compass and the Summoning Compass are given.
At every death, each player standing on the central island (within 192 blocks of its centre) receives the compass of every structure already unlocked, unless they already carry one.

The mod's blocks (the altar, the fountain, the table, the bench and the compressor) can all be mined and taken home. At every dragon death, each structure puts back the mod blocks that are missing from it, and leaves everything else alone.
From the 6th death on, every death also rebuilds the five structures entirely, block by block, wherever the world differs. Empty spaces are never cleared, so what you built in the gaps stays.
A gift from the dragon itself
Slay the dragon with a weapon carrying winged energy and it sheds twelve Dragon Scales, the heart of the two mythic pairs. Every new dragon is another chance.
